purpose: Teach: カヌー/画廊/怪人/鳥獣/合奏/ファインダー/随筆/ハサミ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、夏休みにカヌー教室行ったろ?
lines.en: Hey, didn't you go to canoe class over summer break?
lines.style: Casual, teasing opener. Light curiosity — she's testing whether he'll bite. Knowing smile underneath. Quick pace, like she already knows the answer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、画廊巡りが趣味だろ、桜
lines.en: You're the one obsessed with gallery tours, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry deflection. Turning it back on her — not defensive, just evening the score. Slight smirk in the voice. Quiet confidence that she'll appreciate the callback.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、特撮ヒーローの怪人好きだろ?
lines.en: Wait, you actually like those tokusatsu monster designs, don't you?
lines.style: Realization dawning mid-sentence. Genuine surprise mixing with delight at catching him. Pitch up slightly on the realization. Playful edge — she's pleased with herself.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で鳥獣戯画の単元やったろ?桜
lines.en: You learned about the Animal Scroll in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Measured counterattack. Almost formal in structure — mirroring her rhythm to show he's keeping up. Slight warmth underneath the cool delivery. Not letting her win.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、吹奏楽部の合奏会で頑張ってたな
lines.en: You know, you actually worked really hard at that ensemble concert with the band.
lines.style: Genuine praise breaking through — softer than her teasing tone. Slight vulnerability in admitting he noticed. Warm, steady delivery. Not overdoing it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、カメラのファインダー覗き過ぎだろ、桜
lines.en: You spend way too much time looking through that camera viewfinder, Sakura.
lines.style: Wry observation delivered without edge. Fond exasperation — the tone of someone watching their friend disappear into their hobby and finding it kind of endearing. Dry pace, slight laugh at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、国語で随筆の単元やったろ?
lines.en: Didn't you study essays in Japanese class?
lines.style: Matching her rhythm from earlier — turning the tables back. Curious but measured. The volley continuing. Light, almost rhythmic delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、図工でハサミの使い方上手かったな、桜
lines.en: Your scissors technique in craft class was actually pretty solid, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity returning. Admission of noticing a small skill. Warm but restrained — teenage boys don't gush. Simple, genuine tone. Small moment of real attention.
